messages.subject: Multilevel Moderated Mediation 1-1-1 | Centering, Syntax, Covariates, Plot
parts:
Dear friends, 

Thank you for your excellent support; this is truly an amazing community. 

I am trying to test a multilevel moderated mediation model (1-1-1 with a moderation effect at the first stage of the model). I am puzzled whether my syntax is correct and I also have a few questions that have not seen in any other thread. 

This is my model (all variables are level 1 clustered withing level-2 supervisors):

# Variable included in the model

MED=mediator

Y=DV

MOD=moderator

X=IV

INT=MOD * X

# I have already created INT (interaction of Mod * X) using the centered values of Mod and X.

Question 1: Should I group mean center  the IV and MOD, use the initial values or grand mean-center them? I have not seen any post raising this issue related to the lavaan package.

#Multilevel moderated mediation SEM 1-1-1 (intercepts only). Moderation at stage 1 of the mediation model. 

model<-'

level:1

MED ~ w*MOD + a*X + aw*INT 

Y ~ b*MED + c*X

MOD ~ MODmean*1

MOD ~~ MODvar*MOD

MOD ~~ X + INT

X ~~ INT

 

level:2

MED ~ w2*MOD + a2*X + aw2*INT

Y ~ b*MED + c2*X

MOD ~~ X + INT

X ~~ INT

MOD ~~ MOD

X ~~ X

INT ~~ INT

 

indirect.within.SDbelow:=(a+aw*(MODmean-sqrt(MODvar)))*b #to estimate the indirect effect at -1SD

indirect.within.SDabove:=(a+aw*(MODmean +sqrt(MODvar)))*b

index.mod.med:= b*aw #test the differences between indirect effects

Mod.SDabove:=(a+aw*( MODmean +sqrt(MODvar))) #probe the moderation effect at stage 1 of the model

Mod.SDbelow:=(a+aw*( MODmean -sqrt(MODvar)))

'

fit<-sem(model,data=mydata, cluster=”ID", se="standard")

summary(fit,fit.measures=TRUE)

lavInspect(fit,"icc")

 

Question 2: Do I miss anything in the above syntax? Multilevel moderated mediation is really hot but no one seems to provide some clear instructions. 

Question 3: How can I plot the effects?

Question 4: If I wanted to include different control variable at level1 and level 2, where should I include them? Wouldn't that increase the complexity of the model?

I greatly appreciate your time and help on these issues! 

Best regards,

Ilias

Preacher et al (2010) is the "go to" reference here.  You can easily take the Mplus code for the 1-1-1 model from the online appendix and adapt it to lavaan.  As for centering, you might consider having a look at Enders and Tofighi (2007) regarding the different types and their consequences for estimates.  Heck and Thomas (2015) is an excellent reference for both issues, too.  

One last thing.  One might indicate mediated structures at both the within and between levels rather than the method described above (i.e., mediation at the within level, variable variances at the between).  Usually, one has good conceptual reasons for doing so, for example, the emergence of collective constructs (see Kozlowski et al., 2013).  Doing so in effect sets up a contextual model (see Marsh, et al., 2009; Jak, 2018), which effectively compares the effect of the group-mean deviated scores at the individual level to that of the group means at the between level. Hox et al. (2018) is a nice resource for understanding multilevel factor/SEM models in terms of what the covariance matrices at each level consist of.

Hope this helps.

Joe

On Sun, Aug 23, 2020 at 5:41 PM Ilias Kapoutsis <i.kap...@gmail.com> wrote:

Dear friends, 

Thank you for your excellent support; this is truly an amazing community. 

I am trying to test a multilevel moderated mediation model (1-1-1 with a moderation effect at the first stage of the model). I am puzzled whether my syntax is correct and I also have a few questions that have not seen in any other thread. 

This is my model (all variables are level 1 clustered withing level-2 supervisors):

# Variable included in the model

MED=mediator

Y=DV

MOD=moderator

X=IV

INT=MOD * X

# I have already created INT (interaction of Mod * X) using the centered values of Mod and X.

Question 1: Should I group mean center  the IV and MOD, use the initial values or grand mean-center them? I have not seen any post raising this issue related to the lavaan package.

#Multilevel moderated mediation SEM 1-1-1 (intercepts only). Moderation at stage 1 of the mediation model. 

model<-'

level:1

MED ~ w*MOD + a*X + aw*INT 

Y ~ b*MED + c*X

MOD ~ MODmean*1

MOD ~~ MODvar*MOD

MOD ~~ X + INT

X ~~ INT

 

level:2

MED ~ w2*MOD + a2*X + aw2*INT

Y ~ b*MED + c2*X

MOD ~~ X + INT

X ~~ INT

MOD ~~ MOD

X ~~ X

INT ~~ INT

 

indirect.within.SDbelow:=(a+aw*(MODmean-sqrt(MODvar)))*b #to estimate the indirect effect at -1SD

indirect.within.SDabove:=(a+aw*(MODmean +sqrt(MODvar)))*b

index.mod.med:= b*aw #test the differences between indirect effects

Mod.SDabove:=(a+aw*( MODmean +sqrt(MODvar))) #probe the moderation effect at stage 1 of the model

Mod.SDbelow:=(a+aw*( MODmean -sqrt(MODvar)))

'

fit<-sem(model,data=mydata, cluster=”ID", se="standard")

summary(fit,fit.measures=TRUE)

lavInspect(fit,"icc")

 

Question 2: Do I miss anything in the above syntax? Multilevel moderated mediation is really hot but no one seems to provide some clear instructions. 

Question 3: How can I plot the effects?

Question 4: If I wanted to include different control variable at level1 and level 2, where should I include them? Wouldn't that increase the complexity of the model?

I greatly appreciate your time and help on these issues!

Ilias
